Loss report: gitea -> concourse
[lost] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.filter.branches (the push trigger has no branch filter, and a git resource follows one branch; the resource follows the default branch of the repository)
[lost] pipeline/deploy pipeline.inputs
[lost] pipeline/deploy/trigger/0 ext.passthrough (Ext of provider gha (inputs) is not written to the Concourse file; it is kept in round-trip metadata)
[emulated] pipeline/ci ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/ci trigger.tag: tag twin of each job (a job cannot wait on a branch push and on a tag, because a tag resource has no version on a push; each job has a twin named <job>-tag that follows the tag resource, and the twin of a needed job feeds the twin that needs it)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/test/step/test-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.tag: git resource with source.tag_filter (a tag trigger that also has a branch filter is lost, because one git resource cannot hold both sets)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy ext.passthrough: git-uri variable (the git resources read their uri from ((git-uri)); set it with fly set-pipeline -v git-uri=<uri> or in the credential manager)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy project.multi_pipeline: one pipeline file per IR pipeline under .concourse/ (each pipeline needs its own fly set-pipeline and gets its own triggers)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/deploy job.runner: worker tags of the task (the tasks carry the worker tags ubuntu-latest; a build waits until a worker has them)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/deploy trigger.manual: get with no trigger (no trigger starts the job, so a person starts it)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/deploy/step/deploy-step-1 step.image: default image (the task names no image, so it runs ubuntu:latest)
[emulated] pipeline/deploy/job/deploy/step/deploy-step-1 step.shell: run.path sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the task runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
